name: Custom Shape Wooden Tooth Fairy Door Hanger
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood for durability and a smooth finish.
    - Product includes 3 main decorative layers:
              +) Layer 1 (Main Board): Wooden 3mm.
              +) Layer 2 (Middle Layer – Slot Design): Wooden 5mm, with a hollow slot to hold folded money securely.
               +) Layer 3 (Front Decorative Piece): Wooden 3mm.
    - Includes a built-in mini wooden storage box for tooth placement.
    - Box components (front, sides, bottom) made from wooden 3mm panels. The box front is crafted from a 2-layer wood, with each layer 3 mm thick.
    - Precision laser-cut edges for clean detailing and secure slot-fit assembly.
    - Lightweight yet sturdy construction.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 10 x 4 inches ~ 25.4 x 10.16 cm.
    - Overall size of the mini box: 1.16 inches x 1.16 inches ~ 2.94 cm x 2.94 cm.
    📌 Note: 
    - The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
    - Customers can easily assemble the mini box by fitting together the pre-cut wooden pieces. All parts fit together easily by hand — no tools or glue needed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant and long-lasting colors.
    - Layer 1 (Main Board): 2-sided printing.
    - Layer 2, layer 3: 1-sided printing.
    - Box Bottom and Box Left & Right Sides: 2-sided printing.
    - Box Front (including layer 1 and layer 2): 1-sided printing.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative Tooth Fairy door hanger for children.
    - Features a small wooden box compartment for “Pick Up” – safely storing the baby tooth.
    - Includes a specially designed money slot for “Drop Off” – allowing folded bills to be inserted securely.
    - Easily hangs on standard door handles.
    - Keeps the Tooth Fairy tradition organized, fun, and magical.
    - Reusable keepsake for multiple childhood milestones.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A charming and personalized gift for children losing their first tooth.
    - Perfect for birthdays, baby milestones, and childhood celebrations.
    - A thoughtful keepsake parents can save as a memory.
    - Encourages magical family traditions and joyful experiences.
    - A meaningful decorative piece for kids’ bedrooms 🎁.

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape Wooden Tooth Fairy Door Hanger

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
